text: Ndaarii haawuɗaa ɓe -an Nulaaɗo- ko honno ɓe sifor maa sifaaji meereeji. Ɓe wi'i: "Ko a mbileejo". Ɓe wi'i kadi: "Ko a mbilɗaaɗo". Ɓe wi'i kadi: "ko a feetuɗo". Ɓe majjii e Goonga kan sabu ɗum, ɓe hattantaake naatugol e laawol Peewal ngal, ɓe hattantah kadi [heɓude] laawol fii tukkugol hoolaare maaɗa nden e goongugol maaɗa ngol.
